worldcombat.skill.doubleslap.summary: Two palms take turns at point-blank: one hand after the other slaps back and forth, nudging the target sideways with every hit. The facing locks at the start and it keeps the same close foe; the crossing mode is many light slaps that wobble it, the straight mode is fewer, heavier slaps.
worldcombat.skill.doubleslap.use.0: A burst of fast little slaps at point-blank range
worldcombat.skill.doubleslap.use.1: Pile damage on a low-defence target through sheer slap count
worldcombat.skill.doubleslap.use.2: Crossing mode wobbles the target left and right to break its footing
worldcombat.skill.doubleslap.use.3: Aim at a bare direction and an empty palm just ends the string
worldcombat.skill.doubleslap.description: Slap a single close foe at point-blank: each slap deals about %1$s physical damage, and the string throws up to %2$s slaps (2-5, set by the user's data).

Slaps come every %1$s, each judged in its own palm's short fan within %2$s blocks; each slap rolls %3$s to hit, and a whiff ends the string. Only the foe locked at the start is kept - if it drops or is knocked out of the palm fan the string ends early.
Crossing mode knocks the target about %1$s blocks to the opposite side (0 in straight mode).
worldcombat.skill.doubleslap.cross.on: Crossing: both hands alternate, each slap knocks the target to the opposite side and the string can reach 5 slaps; costs per-slap power x0.85, slightly shorter reach and cooldown +2 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.doubleslap.cross.off: Straight: the same hand keeps slugging, per-slap power x1.2 and slightly longer reach; costs a string capped at 4 slaps and no sideways nudge at all.
worldcombat.skill.doubleslap.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.doubleslap.growth.0: From level %1$s the per-slap power rises to %2$s and the string grows to %3$s slaps.
worldcombat.skill.doubleslap.growth.1: From level %1$s the per-slap power rises to %2$s and the reach to %3$s blocks.
On (crossing): both hands alternate, each slap knocks the target to the opposite side and the string can reach 5 slaps; costs per-slap power x0.85, slightly shorter reach and cooldown +2 ticks. Off (straight): the same hand keeps slugging, per-slap power x1.2 and slightly longer reach; costs a string capped at 4 slaps and no sideways nudge.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. This move has a very short reach, so the default is small too.

On: targets that barely move (pinned, against a wall, standing still) rank higher because they eat the whole string; fast movers that can slip out of the palm fan rank lower. Off: all targets score the same.
On: the user will leave its station for Double Slap; off: it only casts when already in reach.
world_combat.move.doubleslap.text.away: The target slipped out of reach (%1$s slaps landed)
world_combat.move.doubleslap.text.empty: No target within the palm fan
